request.voice_description: Native North American English, a clear general American dialect. Female, 24 to 30. Excellent clean recording quality. Persona: meticulous junior infantry leader. Emotion: attentive, determined, tightly wound. A bright middle-register feminine voice with precise consonants and quick thoughtful phrasing. She begins formally, choosing each word carefully. Under pressure her pace accelerates, her breath shortens and a small self-correction slips out, but her words remain intelligible. Earnest rather than theatrical; a human catch in the voice beneath practiced procedure. Capable of a sudden forceful warning, then consciously slowing herself back down. Natural spoken character dialogue.
request.text:
[precise, focused voice] Command, Relay. Position confirmed. Awaiting instructions.

[quick, tense voice] Contact! Enemy contact! We are engaged!

[strained, fast voice] Enemy mech confirmed. Yes, definitely a mech. Find cover!

[shouting, urgent voice] Check your fire! We are friendlies!

[breathless, deliberately slower voice] Command, Relay. Still with you. Say again. Slowly.
